raw_text: InfoOps Watch has catalogued the Pakistani CIB campaign targeting the Article 370 anniversary. Key findings: 2,100+ accounts activated within 6-hour window, 87% created in July 2024, identical posting cadence of 12-15 tweets per hour. Content includes fabricated atrocity images with metadata stripped, coordinated hashtag amplification, and targeted engagement with UN human rights accounts. Network architecture consistent with previous ISPR-attributed campaigns.
